related_issues.title: add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: This is the issue being researched; requires adding PHP to supported languages

constraints: tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 is the latest stable version (from Cargo.toml inspection)
PHP grammar defines function_definition (not function_declaration) for top-level functions and method_declaration for class methods
PHP has class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration as declaration types
Inheritance in PHP: class_declaration has base_clause child for extends; class_interface_clause child for implements
interface_declaration has base_clause child for extends; enum_declaration has class_interface_clause child for implements
All declaration nodes have name field of type name (not identifier)

DEFUSE_QUERY is required for all languages that support def-use analysis (Java, Python, Go, C++, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Swift, Kotlin all have it; Fortran does not; CSS, YAML, Markdown do not)
No web search available; all research via gh CLI and Context7
test_coverage: Existing test patterns in language modules: (1) query compilation and matching (ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY); (2) extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance handler functions; (3) defuse site detection (Write, WriteRead, Read kinds); (4) integration tests verify analyze_file and analyze_directory work with language-specific code. For PHP, tests should cover: function_definition extraction, method_declaration extraction, class/interface/trait/enum extraction, base_clause and class_interface_clause inheritance extraction, defuse sites in function bodies, and proper handling of PHP-specific syntax (visibility modifiers, attributes, readonly, etc.)

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration nodes with name field; base_clause and class_interface_clause for inheritance
library_findings.notes: Cargo.toml shows MIT license, actively maintained by tree-sitter org. Node types confirmed via gh api inspection of php/src/node-types.json. All declaration types have required name field and optional body field.

library_findings.relevant_api: Query::new(), QueryCursor, Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Core tree-sitter API used consistently across all language modules. Bounds checking pattern: if end <= source.len() { Some(source[start..end].to_string()) } else { None }

approaches.name: Minimal PHP support (no DEFUSE_QUERY)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression), REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY. Omit DEFUSE_QUERY. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml.
pros: Covers basic element and call extraction
cons: No def-use analysis for PHP; inconsistent with most supported languages (Java, Python, Go, C++, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Swift, Kotlin all have DEFUSE_QUERY)
Violates principle that mature languages should have full feature parity

approaches.name: Full PHP support with DEFUSE_QUERY (recommended)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering all declaration types, CALL_QUERY covering all call expression types, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and DEFUSE_QUERY capturing local variable declarations, assignments, augmented assignments, and identifier reads. Implement extract_inheritance handler to walk base_clause and class_interface_clause. Add extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver handlers. Register in mod.rs with all handlers. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Add comprehensive tests covering all declaration types and defuse sites.
pros: Full feature parity with Java, Python, Go, C++, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Swift, Kotlin
Enables def-use analysis for PHP code
Supports inheritance extraction for classes, interfaces, traits, enums
Includes all handler functions for semantic analysis
cons: More implementation work (defuse query, handlers, tests)
Requires careful testing of PHP-specific syntax (attributes, visibility modifiers, readonly, static, abstract, final)

approaches.name: PHP support with optional DEFUSE_QUERY (fallback)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with full ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and DEFUSE_QUERY. Implement extract_inheritance handler. Omit extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver handlers (set to None in LanguageInfo). Register in mod.rs. This provides defuse analysis without method/receiver extraction.
pros: Provides def-use analysis without implementing all handler functions
cons: Method and receiver type extraction not available (may be needed for some use cases)

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP support with DEFUSE_QUERY). PHP is a mature, widely-used language with a well-maintained tree-sitter grammar. The issue explicitly asks for language support, implying feature parity with existing languages. Full DEFUSE_QUERY and handler implementation ensures PHP gets the same semantic analysis capabilities as Java, Python, Go, and other mature languages in the codebase. The medium complexity is justified by the value of complete feature parity and comprehensive test coverage.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(
  function_definition
    name: (name) @func_name) @function
(
  method_declaration
    name: (name) @method_name) @function
(
  class_declaration
    name: (name) @class_name) @class
(
  interface_declaration
    name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(
  trait_declaration
    name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(
  enum_declaration
    name: (name) @enum_name) @class
defuse_query_draft:
(
  local_variable_declaration
    declarator: (variable_declarator
      name: (variable_name) @write.local))
(
  assignment_expression
    left: (variable_name) @write.assign)
(
  augmented_assignment_expression
    left: (variable_name) @writeread.augmented)
(
  update_expression
    (variable_name) @writeread.update)
(
  variable_name) @read.usage
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (php/src/node-types.json): class_declaration node has children array containing base_clause and class_interface_clause. base_clause contains multiple named children of type name, qualified_name, or relative_name (each represents an extends parent). class_interface_clause contains multiple named children of type name, qualified_name, or relative_name (each represents an implements interface). interface_declaration has optional base_clause child (for extends). enum_declaration has optional class_interface_clause child (for implements). Walk from class/interface/enum node to child_by_field_name('base_clause') or child_by_field_name('class_interface_clause'), then iterate named_child() to extract each parent/interface name.
